content.title: American Idol fans suspect two beloved finalists are dating behind the scenes after spotting 3 ‘clues’
content.text: AMERICAN Idol fans suspect two beloved finalists are dating behind the scenes after spotting a slew of clues. Contestants on the hit talent show Brooks Rosser and Rae Boyd are rumored to be dating. Sign up for the Entertainment newsletter Thank you! Fans are convinced they’ve spotted three telltale clues Brooks and Rae are secretly dating Credit: Instagram/raesingz Brooks is still in the competition while Rae has been booted out Credit: Instagram/raesingz Brooks has hyped up Rae in the comments of her thirst traps Credit: Instagram/raesingz Rae was just eliminated from the completion, while Brooks is still in the running to be the winner. We’ve rounded up some of the clues that point to them being embroiled in a budding romance. The first clue is that Brooks made Rae a sign that said Bae. “Vote for Bae,” the sign said, with the “bae” crossed out and “RAE” written next to it in capital letter. Read More about American Idol Red hearts were also drawn on the banner, with this possibly symbolizing a blossoming love story between the pair. Rae posted the photo of Brooks holding up the sign on her Instagram and penned alongside it: “He said he would still vote for me.” Not only this, but Brooks is posting all over her thirst traps, which is the second clue. On her most recent snap shared on Instagram where Rae can be seen donning a brown outfit and posing up a storm, Brooks commented with a heart eye emoji. Most read in TV He also wrote: “I like this channel.” Brooks also penned “Beautiful” beneath a stunning snap of Rae in a pink metallic dress. And not only is Brooks all up in Rae’s comments, but she is also posting in the comments of his posts, marking the third clue. She penned “Hi” beneath one photo and “Denim? I hardly know her” under another. And as a bonus clue, we can share that they have good chemistry when they perform – and fans think so too! They have shared several intimate videos of them singing duets together. Could Brooks end up winning the show? Credit: Getty Brooks and Rae have duetted on social media Credit: Instagram/raesingz Fans spotted the chemistry and were quick to point it out in the comment section. “Truly hope this is a love story in the making,” penned one person. “Love this song and love you both together,” added a second. “It’s not even fair how good you guys sound together,” wrote a third. “Are you guys falling in love?” pressed a fourth. While a fifth swooned: “How cute are they together?!” And a sixth penned: “Plz let this be a love story.” The hit talent show might have sparked a love story between Brooks and Rae Credit: Getty Comments
